local cwd = '$' .. 'ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT'
local function fill(body)
    local out = {}
    local i = 1
    while true do
        local s, e = body:find('@CWD@', i, true)
        if not s then
            out[#out + 1] = body:sub(i)
            break
        end
        out[#out + 1] = body:sub(i, s - 1)
        out[#out + 1] = cwd
        i = e + 1
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
